initialExam.title: NABARD Grade A Officer 2025-26
initialExam.conductingBody: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
initialExam.description: NABARD Grade A exam for development assistant managers. 2025-26 cycle completed (result Jan 2026). Next cycle expected Jul-Aug 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree with 60% or Post Graduation with 55%
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: English (40Q), Reasoning (40Q), Quant (20Q), GK/Economy (40Q), Decision Making (10Q), Computer (20Q). Mains: Economic & Social Issues, Agriculture & Rural Development + Descriptive English.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 200 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours. Mains: 100 marks objective + 100 marks descriptive + Interview.
initialExam.careerGrowth: Grade A → Grade B → Grade C → Grade D → CGM → DMD → Chairman.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit nabard.org 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
